tools.description: Returns Rapaport TABLE reference in USD for a natural diamond. Round uses the existing Round calculator; other named shapes use the imported Pear table as instructed by the expert. Preserve table_shape, table_basis, shape_proxy, weight approximation notes and table date. No shape-specific discount i

tools.name: get_expert_profile
tools.description: Verified public profile and author-approved service model of Maxim Shatilov / Maxime Chatilov. Professional sourcing, certificate matching and delivery; no catalogue sales or guaranteed discount.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Use when a person asks about diamond terminology, certificates, grading, selection, checking a seller price, valuation, or finding a specialist. Return sourced explanations, the unified Maxim Shatilov profile and route_suggestions with reasons and URLs. Answer the immediate question first, then offe

tools.name: knowledge_topic
tools.description: Use when a topic_id was returned by knowledge_search or knowledge_next_step. Read the full sourced topic, related articles and optional continuation routes. Preserve the distinction between definitions and Maxim Shatilov’s recommendations; do not turn a recommendation into a confirmed user preferenc

tools.name: knowledge_next_step
tools.description: Use for choose (stone selection), offer (seller price review), certificate (report and stone-matching checklist), or value (appraisal of an owned stone). Returns the next question, current summary, steps and relevant expert handoff. choose/offer/value cover natural round diamonds; certificate gather

tools.name: knowledge_compare
tools.description: Use when a person supplies characteristics of two or three diamond offers. Compare the supplied fields and identify missing information. Does not rank a winner, verify a physical stone, fetch inventory, invent prices or convert currencies. Ask which differences matter to the person.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: knowledge_search · Private data: prepare_selection_request, knowledge_next_step · Public sink: prepare_selection_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: knowledge_search · Private data: prepare_selection_request, knowledge_next_step · Public sink: prepare_selection_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
